audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] fabricates 'Rewrite the Stars' for Mel's R (really Golden Eclipse) and calls her reflect 'Solar Snare' (Solar Snare is her E root; the reflect is Rebuttal, W). Cooldowns field had no numbers.
audit.why: Riot kit: Q Radiant Volley 10-6s, W Rebuttal 38-26s reflect, E Solar Snare 11-9s root, R Golden Eclipse detonates Overwhelm at any range.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten with real names; Rebuttal cooldown numbers added; W-only reflect scoped (Syndra Q is placed, not a projectile).

edits.before: - Mel Rebuttal: matchup-defining — Reflects your projectiles back — never poke while it glows. It governs your forward steps. - E Scatter the Weak spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Mel's R (Rewrite the Stars) is a global-ish execute nuke, but she has no escape and folds to your all-in, so 6 is your window to kill her outright. Land E-Q into QQ+R before she can react; if she tries to reflect with her W (Solar Snare / reflect), bait it with a sphere first. She cannot survive a full combo at this stage.
edits.after: Mel's R (Golden Eclipse) detonates her Overwhelm stacks from any range, but she has no escape and folds to your all-in, so 6 is your window to kill her outright. Land E-Q into QQ+R before she can react; if she tries to reflect with Rebuttal (W), bait it with a thrown sphere first. She cannot survive a full combo at this stage.
